positions.title: Senior Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Sable is Amazon's leading NoSQL storage and computation platform. Offered as a hosted service, over 2000 teams use Sable for high performance storage, caching, and new business object derivation services to power retail and digital customer experience.

As the senior engineer for Sable's control plane team, I deliver highly leveraged software components and provide high-level technical direction with the goal of improving the efficiency with which we're able to own and operate one of the largest databases on the planet.
